tldr: Harry walked two colleagues through his Waypoint workflow: onboarding services, then action-ticket, plan and programme tiers, with persona-based plan review.
Speaker 1 wants to focus on architecture diagrams (C4/Mermaid-style) to give agents the right context and document undocumented services, including an onboarding-process diagram.

A third colleague joined to say the customer behind a new project hasn't been asked what they need. The team may start by mirroring Dispatch Cloud features one for one, adding analytics and removing unused parts later.
Harry will send over the skills extracted from orient; Waypoint also works with plain Obsidian.
Harry showed that he has onboarded all Fuse customers, with per-customer connector setups visible.
decisions: Start without customer input if needed: mirror Dispatch Cloud as closely as possible, add analytics, then remove unused features.
Aim to release by Monday, with changes possible afterwards.

actions.text: Extract the Waypoint skills from orient so they can be run standalone, and send them to Speaker 1 and Speaker 2.
Ask Steph whether they have extra context on what the customer needs for the Dispatch Cloud work.
Join the customer meeting to ask the basic questions and feed any answers back to Harry.
Build architecture diagrams for services, starting with one for the Iris onboarding process.

questions: What does the customer actually need from the Dispatch Cloud replacement, and which options will they use?
Do customers want to see and configure the headless selector themselves, or have it as a paid managed service?
